"Ribbons & Devotion - A Belle & Penny Series

This is the main (Plot A) storyline I've been writing. It follows Penny, a nerdy Braixen hopelessly devoted to her trainer, and Belle, a tsundere Sylveon who swears she hates humans but can't fight her own biology. Belle has an excuse for everything, from stealing her trainer's clothes to refusing to leave his side, while Penny happily meddles in the background. What starts as a battle between Belle's pride and her instincts is quickly turning into something much bigger, and the household is about to grow."- Artist
